description: This file implements a decrypt bridge for handling encrypted Matrix events, including retry logic, event handling, and integration with crypto signals.

classes.name: MatrixDecryptBridge
classes.description: A class managing decryption retries, event handling, and integration with crypto signals for Matrix encrypted events.

methods.name: shouldEmitUnencryptedMessage
methods.description: Determines if an unencrypted message should be emitted based on deduplication logic.

methods.name: attachEncryptedEvent
methods.description: Attaches an encrypted event to be decrypted and tracked.

methods.name: retryPendingNow
methods.description: Triggers immediate retry of all pending decryptions.

methods.name: bindCryptoRetrySignals
methods.description: Binds crypto retry signals to trigger retries on specific crypto events.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all retry attempts and clears scheduled retries.

methods.name: drainPendingDecryptions
methods.description: Waits for all pending decryptions to complete or reach retry limit.

methods.name: handleEncryptedEventDecrypted
methods.description: Handles decrypted events, manages retries on failure, and emits events.

methods.name: emitFailedDecryptionOnce
methods.description: Emits a failed decryption notification only once per event.

methods.name: scheduleDecryptRetry
methods.description: Schedules a retry for a failed decryption with exponential backoff.

methods.name: runDecryptRetry
methods.description: Performs a decryption retry, with backoff and retry limit logic.

methods.name: clearDecryptRetry
methods.description: Clears scheduled retries and notifications for a specific event.

methods.name: rememberDecryptedMessage
methods.description: Stores a record of a decrypted message for deduplication.

methods.name: pruneDecryptedMessageDedupe
methods.description: Removes old entries from the decrypted message deduplication map.

methods.name: waitForActiveRetryRunsToFinish
methods.description: Waits until all active retry runs are completed.

methods.name: resolveRetryIdleIfNeeded
methods.description: Resolves all pending waiters when retry runs are finished.
